title: A slow terminal viewer resyncs without losing output
description: Use a disposable authenticated gateway, a local slot and a private tmux socket. One viewer stops reading while the pane floods; the gateway must close it for a resync, deliver everything it sent without a gap, keep the healthy viewer streaming, and let the slow viewer re-attach to the current screen. No product slot or shared tmux server.

slow-viewer.intent: Close a terminal viewer whose unsent output passes the buffer limit with code 1013, never skip a chunk it was sent, and redraw the current screen when it subscribes again.
